The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

The paragraph describes a bank implementing background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). This action is compliant with legal standards, as the FCRA regulates the collection, dissemination, and use of consumer credit information, and requires employers to obtain proper consent and follow specific procedures when conducting background checks for employment purposes. The bank's policy explicitly aims to meet these federal regulatory standards.
